title: Concept: Embed element loads third-party content
description: An embed element with a source in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The embed element loads a plugin document that the page cannot sandbox or inspect, and plugin content has historically carried its own script-execution surface.
applicability: Legacy PDF viewers, media players and document preview pages.
risk: Plugin content runs outside the page's script policy, so the CSP does not constrain it.
